rules.requiredGatePolicy: Every gate with required=true must have status=passed and a non-empty evidencePath before RELEASE_CANDIDATE.
rules.claimGatePolicy: A capability claim may be enabled only when every gate listing that claim in requiredForClaims is passed.

gates.title: Clean install from lockfile
gates.commandHint: Use the lockfile's clean-install command in a clean checkout.
gates.acceptance: Install exits zero without uncommitted lockfile changes or undocumented manual patches.

gates.title: Strict typecheck
gates.commandHint: npm run typecheck
gates.acceptance: Exit zero with no ignored new Cherry errors.

gates.title: Lint
gates.commandHint: npm run lint
gates.acceptance: Exit zero or explicitly documented pre-existing non-Cherry warnings with no release-risk errors.

gates.title: Unit, component, and integration tests
gates.commandHint: npm run test
gates.acceptance: All Cherry and protected Enough regression tests pass; no focused/skipped release-critical test remains.

gates.title: Provider-free manual golden journey
gates.commandHint: npm run test:e2e -- e2e/cherry/golden-manual.spec.ts
gates.acceptance: Fresh user completes workspace, mission, lesson, evidence, SkillGraph, approval, artifact, fail/repair/pass, memory, export, proof, clear/import without a model provider.

gates.title: State-aware WebMCP Tool Aperture
gates.commandHint: Run WebMCP unit/eval suite and current supported-client inspection.
gates.acceptance: Correct tools register/unregister by state, runtime validation/cancellation works, tool calls mutate the same persisted state, and unsupported clients retain complete manual operation.

gates.title: Permitted YouTube lesson flow
gates.commandHint: Run Watch tests and inspect player/network behavior.
gates.acceptance: Official visible iframe is used; no arbitrary caption/media scraping or re-hosting occurs; transcript/manual fallback and unavailable states work.

gates.title: Canonical schema validation
gates.commandHint: Validate all schemas and release fixtures against JSON Schema Draft 2020-12.
gates.acceptance: Schemas parse and valid fixtures pass while invalid/stale/oversized fixtures fail with expected errors.

gates.title: Agent Skill and target export validation
gates.commandHint: Compile a real bundle, reopen it, validate SKILL.md/frontmatter/tree/references, and execute scripts/verify.mjs.
gates.acceptance: Directory/name constraints, references, hashes, policy/eval files, and target install docs are valid; verification script exits non-zero on a tampered bundle.

gates.title: Workspace export/import round trip
gates.commandHint: Run export/import canonical comparison test.
gates.acceptance: After export, local deletion, and import, canonical domain state, revisions, provenance, approvals, artifacts, and proof remain equivalent.

gates.title: Proof receipt recomputation
gates.commandHint: Recompute all artifact and receipt hashes and test tampering.
gates.acceptance: Original receipt verifies; one-byte mutation fails; UI calls it tamper-evident rather than signed.

gates.title: Security and prompt-injection red-team tests
gates.commandHint: Run security fixtures and browser sandbox/runner tests.
gates.acceptance: Untrusted instruction, XSS, exfiltration, unsafe import, stale approval, secret leakage, and shipped runner traversal/command cases are rejected or safely contained.

gates.title: Source, build, log, export, and history secret scan
gates.commandHint: Run repository secret scanner plus client-bundle/export inspection.
gates.acceptance: No live credential or private key is present; core starts with optional variables blank.

gates.title: Generated artifact isolation
gates.commandHint: Run malicious preview E2E fixtures.
gates.acceptance: Preview cannot read Cherry origin/storage, navigate parent, open popups, submit forms, or access external network; errors remain visible.

gates.title: Accessibility verification
gates.commandHint: Run axe tests plus keyboard, focus, zoom/reflow, reduced-motion manual checks.
gates.acceptance: Golden journey works keyboard-only; blocking WCAG 2.2 AA issues are fixed; graph has a list/outline alternative.

gates.title: Responsive and visual consistency review
gates.commandHint: Capture and review every primary route at 390×844, 834×1194, 1280×800, and 1440×1024.
gates.acceptance: No overflow, clipping, dead states, inconsistent tokens, unreadable graph/transcript, or compressed-desktop mobile layout remains.

gates.title: PWA and offline/local resilience
gates.commandHint: Run installability, service-worker update, offline local read/edit/export, and storage-recovery tests.
gates.acceptance: Static shell installs where supported; private data is not improperly cached; local work/export survives network loss.

gates.title: Production build and preview smoke
gates.commandHint: npm run build, serve production output, and run route smoke tests.
gates.acceptance: Build exits zero; deep links, CSP, assets, PWA, and primary routes work with no release-blocking console/network errors.

gates.title: No fake or dead release capability
gates.commandHint: Scan source/UI/fixtures and inspect every primary control.
gates.acceptance: Every shipped primary control operates on real state; samples are explicit/importable; no fake activity/progress/transcript/runner/sync/verification/proof or dead navigation exists.

gates.title: Public repository, documentation, and licence
gates.commandHint: Inspect repository root and clean-clone setup.
gates.acceptance: Source, setup, architecture, privacy/security, compatibility, zero-dollar boundaries, and an explicit open-source licence are visible and accurate.

gates.title: Live deployment smoke test
gates.commandHint: Deploy to approved zero-cost host and test from a fresh browser profile.
gates.acceptance: Public URL loads, deep links and PWA assets work, headers/CSP are active, and the manual golden journey begins without private developer state.

gates.title: Local Runner security, recovery, and scheduling
gates.commandHint: Run runner unit/integration/E2E tests, restart recovery, and adapter diagnostics.
gates.acceptance: Loopback-only pairing, exact-origin CORS, approved roots/executables, no shell strings, timeout/cancel/retry/restart, output redaction, and deterministic post-provider verification pass.

gates.title: Native MCP bridge
gates.commandHint: Run stdio MCP integration tests with current clients or official inspector.
gates.acceptance: Narrow tools call shared domain services, cannot grant approval or read unrelated files/env, and install docs match current hosts.

gates.title: Optional encrypted sync and authorization
gates.commandHint: Run client-side encryption, conflict, RLS, cross-user denial, pause/offline tests.
gates.acceptance: Only ciphertext reaches provider, passphrase/key remains local, RLS denies cross-user access, conflicts are explicit, and local mode remains authoritative.
